options.method: Compute mean, max, or standard deviation within each 1-minute interval.
options.advantages: Maintains 1-minute sequence grid (360 steps = 360 minutes), preventing massive feature dimension expansion. Directly compatible with current PatchTST patching logic.
options.limitations: Washes out sub-minute fast solar spikes and high-frequency fluctuations.

options.advantages: Preserves highest temporal resolution (5s) for Aditya-L1 instruments.

feature_alignment_audit.timestamp_tolerances: Matches between instruments should fall within a maximum window of +/- 30 seconds for 1-minute aggregated grid, or +/- 2.5 seconds for a 5-second grid.

missing_value_percentages.goes: 0.0% missing values in goes_full.parquet. Telemetry is forward-filled up to a limit of 10 minutes in app/services/ml/dataset_builder.py (line 82).
missing_value_percentages.solexs: 0.0% missing values within the downloaded and processed day parquets. Gaps exist between days due to instrument duty cycles and orbital constraints.

quality_flags.goes: quality_flag column (integer) is available in database table goesxrs. Default is 0. Filled with 0 when missing.
quality_flags.solexs: solexs_sdd2_gti_mask (float) indicating Good Time Intervals is available in master feature table, generated from fits gti extension.
quality_flags.hel1os: Housekeeping data hel1os_hk_* columns provide telemetry diagnostic flags.

feature_alignment_audit.time_synchronization_issues: GOES utilizes UTC GPS-aligned time tags. HEL1OS and SoLEXS report observation time in seconds since instrument epoch or Modified Julian Date (MJD). Conversion using astropy.time.Time(mjd, format='mjd', scale='utc') is required (as implemented in scratch/build_master_feature_table.py lines 33-44). Slight clock drift between satellite reference frames must be handled using interpolation.
